mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 1.0% signals an aggressive monetary easing policy that reduces the risk-free rate, lowering equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points from the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 1 month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales signals a broad-based collapse in consumer demand, triggering negative equity feedback loops and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary regime, a monthly decline in industrial production exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines > 0.5% during recession, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in total nonfarm payrolls signals weakening labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts exceeding 1.0% from the prior month signals housing sector contraction, triggering negative sentiment shifts and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST declines > 1.0% in 1 month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and a rise in the core inflation rate signals monetary policy uncertainty, increasing real interest rate volatility and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-2008 crisis regime with interest rates at the zero lower bound, a further decline in the federal funds rate signals expanded monetary stimulus, boosting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods during the post-2008 crisis regime when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
